campaign.title: The Long March
campaign.premise: A mobile fortress crosses a ruined continent carrying people, tools, and the last working promises between settlements.
campaign.player_role: The newly appointed marchmaster responsible for keeping the fortress moving and useful.
campaign.regional_objective: Reach the Meridian Refuge before the ash season closes the eastern passes.

chapters.title: The Road Out
chapters.summary: Learn the chassis, complete a first contract, and discover that every useful module creates a dependency.
chapters.player_question: Can this fortress move without becoming helpless?

chapters.title: The Broken Relay
chapters.summary: A communications line fails, forcing a choice between signal range, armor, and movement speed.
chapters.player_question: What is a fortress worth if it cannot hear the road?

chapters.title: The Ash Meridian
chapters.summary: Storms and Burrowers attack the lower hull, making recovery and redundant systems essential.
chapters.player_question: How much redundancy can the fortress afford?

chapters.title: The Weight of Shelter
chapters.summary: The fortress takes on refugees and must decide whether cargo, armor, or mobility matters most.
chapters.player_question: What does the machine owe the people inside it?

chapters.title: The Last March
chapters.summary: The fortress faces the final road, where its accumulated dependencies and relationships are tested together.
chapters.player_question: Did we build a machine that can survive without one perfect part?

locations.name: Ashgate Depot
locations.story_function: Introduces the fortress, contracts, refits, and the cost of being stationary.
locations.visual_motif: Canvas roofs, black rails, amber signal lamps, and chalked repair diagrams.

locations.name: Meridian Refuge
locations.story_function: Represents the future network the fortress is trying to preserve.
locations.visual_motif: White stone terraces, windbreak cloth, and old fortress plates reused as roofs.

locations.name: Broken Relay
locations.story_function: Makes information and signal dependencies physically visible.
locations.visual_motif: A leaning mast, snapped cable, and faded blue route markers.

locations.name: Meridian Pass
locations.story_function: Tests movement, storm preparation, and lower-hull redundancy.
locations.visual_motif: Pale ash dunes, half-buried road ribs, and red warning pennants.

factions.name: The March Settlements
factions.public_position: A moving network is worth more than any one fortified place.
factions.private_pressure: Each settlement wants the fortress to carry its burden first.
factions.content_rule: Settlement support should improve options while creating obligations, never become a passive bonus.

factions.name: Road Raider Companies
factions.public_position: The road belongs to whoever can keep it.
factions.private_pressure: Some companies are predators; others are displaced convoy crews.
factions.content_rule: Raider choices should trade cargo safety against speed, visibility, and political cost.

factions.name: The Relay Keepers
factions.public_position: Information is infrastructure and should not be owned by one fortress.
factions.private_pressure: They are willing to let a route fail to preserve a larger warning network.
factions.content_rule: Relay choices should improve knowledge while asking the player to protect or share it.

characters.name: Mara Flint
characters.motivation: Keep every repairable machine alive long enough to matter.
characters.strength: Improves workshop recovery and temporary repairs.
characters.fear: A fortress that discards people and parts before trying to repair them.
characters.relationship_hook: Mara respects controlled sacrifice but hates waste disguised as efficiency.

characters.name: Iven Pell
characters.motivation: Make the road legible enough that people can choose danger knowingly.
characters.strength: Improves threat forecasts and signal-linked interventions.
characters.fear: A warning that arrives after the decision is already made.
characters.relationship_hook: Iven wants reports shared even when secrecy would make the fortress safer.

characters.name: Sela Vonn
characters.motivation: Reach settlements before the road closes, even if the fortress arrives damaged.
characters.strength: Reduces travel time and improves route-posture choices.
characters.fear: Losing a day while people wait at the next shelter.
characters.relationship_hook: Sela pushes for speed until the crew shows her the true repair cost.

events.title: A Machine That Still Answers
events.setup: The fortress has fuel for one departure and enough parts for one serious repair. The depot offers three ways to make it roadworthy.

choices.label: Spend parts on the engine.
choices.visible_result: The fortress moves reliably, but one cargo rack is removed for the repair rig.

choices.label: Plate the forward hull.
choices.visible_result: The fortress can take a hit, but the first route will be slower.

choices.label: Leave with the parts in the hold.
choices.visible_result: You preserve future flexibility and accept that the first road will expose the unfinished machine.

events.title: The Toll of Being Large
events.setup: A displaced convoy crew approaches under a stolen banner. They know exactly which exterior mount looks unprotected.

choices.label: Power the exterior gun and warn them off.
choices.visible_result: The raiders withdraw, but the fortress broadcasts its firing range.

choices.label: Give up a low-value cargo crate.
choices.visible_result: The convoy passes without violence, and word spreads that the fortress can be negotiated with.

choices.label: Rush the exposed shortcut.
choices.visible_result: You escape the encounter quickly, but the engine now needs attention.

events.title: The Silence Between Lamps
events.setup: The relay mast has gone dark. Iven can restore a weak signal, or the fortress can travel blind and keep its power for the engine.

choices.label: Power the relay coil.
choices.visible_result: The next route forecast becomes clearer, but the fortress begins the crossing with less reserve.

choices.label: Broadcast the relay location to nearby settlements.
choices.visible_result: Help arrives later, but the signal becomes a target.

choices.label: Keep the fortress dark and leave.
choices.visible_result: The fortress is harder to find and harder to prepare.

events.title: The Sky Comes Down
events.setup: A wall of ash is crossing the pass. The fortress can slow, seal, or keep its exposed equipment active to maintain a route signal.

choices.label: Seal the exterior mounts and wait.
choices.visible_result: The fortress loses time but reaches the pass with its exposed systems intact.

choices.label: Keep moving through the ash.
choices.visible_result: The fortress keeps its schedule and emerges with multiple systems strained.

choices.label: Drop the relay mast and protect the engine.
choices.visible_result: The fortress preserves movement but abandons the warning network behind it.

tracks.purpose: Improves route choices and weather knowledge without removing uncertainty.

endings.title: The Road Keeps Moving
endings.summary: The fortress arrives not as a lone survivor but as the first moving link in a repaired network.
endings.crew_note: Iven broadcasts the route. Mara starts a workshop under the refuge terraces.

endings.title: The Fortress Stays
endings.summary: The fortress reaches the refuge slowly and becomes a permanent shelter, workshop, and defensive anchor.
endings.crew_note: Sela gives up the road. Mara says a machine can have a second life.

endings.title: The Last Convoy Through
endings.summary: The fortress remains scarred but fast, carrying the final tools and people through before the pass closes.
endings.crew_note: Sela marks the route in red. Iven refuses to call it safe.

endings.title: Still Answering
endings.summary: The fortress reaches the refuge missing pieces but carrying enough people and knowledge to begin again.
endings.crew_note: Mara hangs the broken parts above the workshop door so nobody calls survival effortless.
